info.name: SearchJobs API (POST /api/jobs/sync)
info.description: Covers POST /api/jobs/sync: enqueues DispatchSyncJob via Hangfire (fire-and-forget) and returns 202 Accepted with the enqueued Hangfire job id. No request body. No auth is configured on this project yet. Open {{baseUrl}}/hangfire (the Hangfire Dashboard) to watch the enqueued job move through Processing/Succeeded/Failed, or {{baseUrl}}/hangfire/jobs/details/{{jobId}} for one specific run.

variable.description: Set by 'Trigger Sync -> 202'; the Hangfire job id returned in the response body.
